resources.string: Magazine groups articles by day and folds read ones away. Swipe the feed left or right to change category; article swipe actions apply to List and Card.
Flip shows one page at a time. Swipe up for the next page, left or right to change category. Pages you flip past count as read when marking while scrolling is on.
Thumbnails and summaries from article pages

For articles with a missing or tiny image, or no summary, use the share image and description from the article page. Each new article page is checked once, after a refresh. Needed for summaries in news sitemap feeds.
